analysis: Aldosterone primarily acts on the distal tubules and the collecting ducts of the nephron in the kidney. It promotes sodium reabsorption and potassium excretion, which helps in regulating blood pressure and fluid balance in the body. While it has significant effects on the collecting duct, its primary site of action is the distal tubule.
